mcpToolDescriptions.missions.list: Discover durable missions (optional query). Prefer list/get before creating duplicates. Business status is not a lock — use claims for exclusive work. See docs/AGENT_USAGE.md v1.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.get: Get one durable mission by id. Read checklist/sources/events next for context before claiming or updating.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.create: Create a durable mission (business state). Set status todo when actionable. Does not claim or create a run — call missions.claim when exclusive execution is required.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.update: Patch durable mission fields including business status (backlog…done/blocked). Never use status as an execution lock; use missions.claim / renew / release.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.checklist.list: List ordered checklist gates for a mission (progress decomposition).
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.checklist.add: Add an ordered checklist gate to a mission.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.checklist.update: Update a checklist item (text, done, position) owned by the mission.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.checklist.remove: Remove a checklist item owned by the mission.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.sources.list: List linked sources (docs/links) for a mission.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.sources.add: Attach a unique source path/URL (kind doc|link). Prefer sources over stuffing large docs into the body.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.sources.remove: Remove a source owned by the mission.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.events.list: List append-only mission audit events (includes claim.acquired/renewed/expired/released and expiry diagnosis).
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.claim.get: Get the active non-expired claim for a mission, if any. Null means the mission is free to claim.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.claim: Atomically claim a mission with a lease and create the linked RUNNING execution run + session. One open claim per mission; conflict → claim_conflict. Prefer this over runs.create when exclusive work is required. See docs/AGENT_USAGE.md v1.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.claim.renew: Renew/heartbeat an owned active claim lease. Fails if not owned, already released, or expired.
mcpToolDescriptions.missions.claim.release: Release an owned claim. completed requires summary+evidence and terminalizes the run COMPLETED; failed|abandoned terminalizes FAILED. Couples claim and run in one transaction.
mcpToolDescriptions.runs.list: List execution runs for a mission (newest first), optionally filtered by typed purpose. Legacy runs may have purpose=null.
mcpToolDescriptions.runs.create: Create a run without claiming, optionally with typed purpose (research|implementation|runtime_verification|independent_review|incident_analysis|maintenance|migration|benchmark|other). Prefer missions.claim for exclusive work.
mcpToolDescriptions.runs.updateStatus: Update run status (PENDING|RUNNING|COMPLETED|FAILED). After claim expiry/reclaim, previous owners are fenced (claim_fenced). Prefer claim.release for terminalization on claimed work.
mcpToolDescriptions.runs.listEvents: List execution events for a run (status changes, claim events, summaries, evidence).
mcpToolDescriptions.runs.recordSummary: Append a typed summary (agent_self_report|research_report|reviewer_validated|operator_note) with optional provenance metadata. Required before claim.release completed.
mcpToolDescriptions.runs.listSummaries: List summaries for a run, optionally filtered by summary type.
mcpToolDescriptions.runs.recordEvidence: Append evidence (kind, label, uri, metadata). When research taxonomy is supplied, source_type must be one of observed_runtime|real_data|code_config|internal_doc|external_primary|external_community|inference.
mcpToolDescriptions.runs.listEvidence: List evidence references for a run.
mcpToolDescriptions.research.listReports: List all research_report summaries for research-purpose runs on a mission, newest first. The first item is canonical; older reports remain visible.
mcpToolDescriptions.research.getCanonicalReport: Return the canonical research report for a mission: the newest research_report summary attached to a run with purpose=research, or null.
